mapper.update: UPDATE t_import_row SET raw_row_content_enc = NULL, raw_nonce = NULL, raw_tag = NULL, raw_deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE raw_retention_until < NOW(3) AND raw_deleted_at IS NULL AND row_status NOT IN ('PENDING', 'REVIEW_NEEDED')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_import_row WHERE record_type = 'UPLOAD_SESSION' AND expires_at < NOW(3) AND upload_status IN ('UPLOADING', 'ASSEMBLING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_import_row SET upload_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{id} AND record_type = 'UPLOAD_SESSION' AND expires_at < NOW(3) AND upload_status IN ('UPLOADING', 'ASSEMBLING', 'FAILED')
